name: Singaporean Trains
author: YellowAquarium
description:
# Subway Builder Singaporean Trains Subway Builder Singaporean Trains is a mod for Subway Builder that adds trains from Singapore's rail network. This pack contains every Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) rolling stock generation, from the original 1987 C151 to the trains being delivered for the Jurong Region and Cross Island Lines, along with every Light Rail Transit (LRT) generation, the Changi Airport Skytrain, the Sentosa Express monorail and the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link. ## Track Types Each line has its own track type, named `{gauge}{line code}-{speed}`. The rubber-tyred LRT and Skytrain lines have no rail gauge, so they use `AGT` in place of the gauge. The Sentosa Express runs on a monorail beam, so it uses `MON`. Trains run only on their own line's track, as no Singapore lines share tracks. Initial builds should be done with a track option where applicable, compatible tracks are listed at the end of the train name; e.g. SG C151 NSEWL 1435NS and SG C151C NSEWL 1435NS can both run on 1435NS-80 tracks. Specific trains can be chosen afterwards in the route menu.
